items.title: Mudaparis — WooCommerce to Shopify migration
items.desc: Over 100 products, a dozen collections and the customer reviews moved from WooCommerce to Shopify using CSV exports and a script. 301 redirects for every old URL, then Horizon theme setup. A brand of traditional Moroccan menswear. November 2025.
details: Exported the WooCommerce catalogue to CSV: over 100 products and more than ten collections.
Imported the products and customer reviews into Shopify with a script.
301 redirects from every old URL to the new Shopify pages.
Set up the Horizon theme in the Shopify editor, no code.

items.title: Amadal — React and headless WordPress rebuild
items.desc: React front end connected to a headless WordPress: API development and admin setup, where the client manages the content. SEO and performance work: homepage renders in under a second, 286 KB transferred, CLS of 0 (measured with PageSpeed Insights). Irrigation systems company. April 2026.
details: Built the front end in React.
WordPress used headless: developed the API that serves content to the front end.
Set up the WordPress admin, where the client edits the site content.
SEO and performance work. Homepage measured with PageSpeed Insights: renders in under a second, 286 KB transferred, CLS of 0.
